course_name_en: Special Problems of Strength of Materials

learning_outcomes.text: Develop logical thinking and basic skills regarding the calculation, design, and operation of complex resistance structures common in mechanical engineering.
Apply acquired knowledge from course topics to solve interdisciplinary engineering problems.

syllabus_topics: Supplementary notions of Strength of Materials: Stresses on inclined sections. Duality of tangential stresses. Shear center. Longitudinal shear.
Stresses beyond the elastic limit: Generalities; Characteristic curve; Tension, bending, and torsion in the elasto-plastic domain; Residual stresses.
Elastic stability: Lateral buckling of beams subjected to bending.
Vessels of revolution: Calculation of thin-walled vessels of revolution (General case, vertical liquid-filled vessel, spherical gas-filled vessel, vertical conical liquid-filled vessel, etc.).
Calculation of thick-walled tubes subjected to internal/external pressure. Tube hooping.
Flat plates: Approximate calculation of flat plates.
Creep and stress relaxation: Long-term mechanical characteristics; Extrapolation methods for creep test results.
Occupational safety and health (OSH) and fire prevention (PSI) norms. Calculation of resistance elements in the elasto-plastic domain.
Determination of principal stresses in resistance elements in a plane stress state: Construction of Mohr's circle.
Expert assessment of steam pipelines in thermal power plants: analytical calculation and finite element simulation.
Determination of the stress concentration factor at the transition from a thin-walled tube to its end cap: numerical simulation.
Determination of stress distribution in the wall of a thick-walled tube subjected to internal pressure and a thermal gradient.
Analytical and numerical determination of stress and strain state in simply supported circular and rectangular plates.
Creep testing of heat-resistant steels; Extrapolation of results.

assessment_methods.method: Practical activities assessment (attendance, lab content knowledge, problem tests, written lab test, involvement in experiments)

assessment_rules: To pass, a minimum grade of 5 is required for both the theoretical part and the practical activities. It is mandatory to obtain a grade of 5 for at least one problem in the theoretical exam. A minimum grade of 5 is also mandatory for the practical activities. Passing any part (theory or problem) is recognized until the end of the respective academic year.
